bp_guide.text: Welcome to Bletchley Park, Station X. In the war this house and its huts read the enemy's secret messages, and almost nobody outside knew.
In 1942 the Daily Telegraph ran a crossword contest, and some who finished it fast enough got a letter asking if they'd do secret war work. All that from a crossword.
Hut 8 is up on the right: Alan Turing's hut. Block H, the National Museum of Computing, is down by the trees. Colossus lives there.
